title: tracks.json
description: Player tracks in pitch metres. The contract between football-tracks and Pitchboard. Positions use the same space as BoardDoc: origin at the top-left corner of a 105 x 68 pitch, x along the length, y across the width. No pixels appear in this file.

startFrame.description: First frame of the segment, in the SOURCE video's numbering. Sample frame indices are absolute, not segment-relative.

id.description: Tracker id. Stable within this file only; it means nothing in another clip.

team.description: Referees are normally dropped before this file is written; the value exists so a debug dump can keep them.

number.description: Shirt number, or null when it could not be read. NEVER a guess (D5) - null imports as a generic token, a wrong number attaches a run to the wrong player invisibly.

samples.description: Sparse and ordered by frame. A player occluded for twenty frames has no sample for them; gaps are expected and must not be invented (D8).

f.description: Absolute frame index in the source video.

conf.description: Detection confidence, carried through so the reduction can weight a fit.

ball.description: Always null in v0 (D4). Shaped like a track so adding it later is not a schema change.
